output.summary: A biennial or perennial plant whose wild form is considered native only to the coasts of France, Great Britain and Spain. It forms a stout rosette of thick, fleshy grey-green leaves before producing branched clusters of four-petalled yellow flowers. Cultivars such as cabbage, broccoli, cauliflower, kale and Brussels sprouts are important human food crops.
output.edibilityNote: Numerous cultivars are eaten as vegetables, including their leaves, stems, buds and flower clusters.
